x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"files\":[{\"type\":\"prostore_file\",\"id\":1234,\"url\":\"https://example.com/foo.pdf\"}]}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/requisitions/%7Brequisition_id%7D/single_pdf_compilers?polling=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
